source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Dense terrain features all carry the Solid rule. Sight lines cannot pass through an enclosed opening in their surface 3" or less above the ground.

Designer's note: models taking cover in terrain at ground level stay unseen despite doors, windows, bullet holes or narrow gaps between neighbouring features; 3" matches a typical first storey, and missions may alter the height used.

A hidden model is gone to ground while:

- intervening dense terrain stops the attacker seeing all of it
- its unit has made no ranged attacks this turn or the one before

While gone to ground, its detection range drops by 3". Designer's note: a unit that shot this turn or last can never go to ground, even with an ability letting it shoot and stay hidden.

Example: a window no higher than 3" in a dense feature stops two units seeing each other through it; gaps higher than 3" do not block sight.
